rows.jp: ベッドに寝転がる。
rows.en: I lay on the bed.

ghs.en: I throw myself on the bed.

rows.jp: 明るいうちに調理は済ませたいところだが。
rows.en: I wanted to get the cooking done while there was still daylight.

ghs.en: I wanted to complete food preparation while it was still bright, but,

rows.jp: 気力がわかない。
rows.en: But I could summon no energy.

ghs.en: my willpower lacks the fire.

rows.jp: 俺の望みは簡単なのに。
rows.en: What I wanted was so simple.

ghs.en: When yet my wish is a simple one.

rows.jp: 攻略ノートまで頼りながら……三日かけて……結束ひとつ取り戻せない。
rows.en: Even with the strategy notebooks to guide me... after three days... I had failed to restore a single bond.

ghs.en: And while I have been relying on the walkthrough notebooks... three days have passed... and I haven't brought back a single piece of our unity.

rows.jp: 結束。
rows.en: Unity.

ghs.en: Unity...

rows.jp: 放送部全員が肩を並べて行う部活動。
rows.en: Every member of the broadcasting club, shoulder to shoulder, working as one.

ghs.en: The Broadcast Club, assembled whole, moving as if one into activities.

rows.en: A bright, cheerful, wholesome radio broadcast.

ghs.en: A cheerful pleasurable wholesome radio broadcast.

rows.jp: ノートはその性質上、結論が記されない。
rows.en: By their very nature, the notebooks never told me how things ended.

ghs.en: Because of the nature of the notebooks, their conclusion is not recorded.

rows.jp: どの方法が、望む結末に近いのか、俺は判断できない。
rows.en: I couldn't tell which approach would bring me closest to the ending I wanted.

ghs.en: Which method approaches the ending I wish is something I cannot discern.

rows.jp: 「木曜、金曜、土曜……」
rows.en: “Thursday, Friday, Saturday...”

ghs.en: Taichi: "Thursday, Friday, Saturday..."

rows.jp: あと何日残っている？
rows.en: How many days remained?

ghs.en: How many days are left now?

rows.jp: 知らなければよかった。
rows.en: I wished I'd never found out—

ghs.en: I would have preferred not knowing,

rows.jp: 世界が終わるなんて。
rows.en: that the world was going to end.

ghs.en: that this world would come to an end.

rows.jp: 「うぅぅ……」
rows.en: “Nnngh...”

ghs.en: Taichi: "Ngggh..."

rows.jp: 低く、呻く。
rows.en: I groaned low in my throat.

ghs.en: A groan, low.

rows.jp: 不思議世界でありながら、もどかしい現実でもある今に対する、憤りだ。
rows.en: It was anger at the present—at this strange world that was still, maddeningly, reality.

ghs.en: The resentment for this frustratingly slow reality that still exists in this inexplicable world.

rows.en: Three or four days at most.

ghs.remedy: Three days, maybe four at most.

highlights.text: Three days at most, at best four.

rows.jp: 「何ができるんだ……それっぽっちの時間で」
rows.en: “What can I do... with so little time?”

ghs.en: Taichi: "A pittance of a time... what could I even do..."

rows.jp: 拳を握って。
rows.en: My fist clenched.

ghs.en: Fists clenching.

rows.jp: グラグラと煮えたぎる感情のうねりが、怒りのそれと似て体を熱くした。
rows.en: A roiling wave of emotion, so much like anger, heated me from within.

ghs.en: The friction of my emotions shaking into a boiling that heats my body in ways that yet resemble anger.

ghs.remedy: The roiling surge of boiling emotion

highlights.text: The friction of my emotions shaking into a boiling

ghs.remedy: Forever---

highlights.text: However long it takes---

rows.jp: 俺は行動した。
rows.en: I took action.

ghs.en: I acted.

rows.jp: ノートにあった記述を参考に、その場その場で最適の行動を取った。
rows.en: With the notebook entries as my guide, I chose what seemed best at every turn.

ghs.en: Consulting the descriptions in the notebook, on the spot and on the fly I took the most suitable actions.

rows.jp: 幸せのため。
rows.en: For happiness.

ghs.en: For the sake of happiness.

rows.jp: 結束を築くため。
rows.en: To forge unity.

ghs.en: For the sake of building unity.

rows.jp: 仲間・友情・絆。

ghs.en: Fellowship - friendship - bonds.

highlights.text: these shamelessly transparent things

rows.jp: これっぽっちの偽善さえ、積むことはできずに―――

ghs.en: Without even the gain of a trifle of hypocrisy---

rows.jp: 金曜日になった。
rows.en: Friday came.

ghs.en: It became Friday.

highlights.text: the role of all-appealing histrion

ghs.en: Our mutual distances continue to feel hopelessly vast.

rows.jp: 半日かけずり回って、成果なし。
rows.en: Half a day of running around, and nothing to show for it.

rows.jp: 「はあ」

rows.jp: 疲れた。
rows.en: I was tired.

rows.en: “Isn’t there some route where we all join Mimi’s club, get along, enjoy a healthy dose of youth, clown around, and laugh?”

ghs.en: Taichi: "Getting everybody in good terms with each other and participating to the Mimi-senpai's club activities, living our adolescence in moderation, joking around, laughing... does that route even exist?"

rows.en: “Isn’t there?”

rows.en: Or maybe she of all people knew.

ghs.en: Her being her, couldn't she possibly know of it?

rows.jp: かすかな希望を抱いて。
rows.en: I let myself cling to that faint hope.

rows.en: “I don’t think so.”

Taichi: "..."

rows.jp: 平坦な調子の声は、いつもより冷たく聞こえる。

rows.jp: 「そんな可能性は、どこにもないと思う」
rows.en: “I don’t think that possibility exists anywhere.”

ghs.en: Youko: "And the world is shaped by these choices."

rows.jp: 「それも、極めて確定的に」
rows.en: “And they do so in an utterly deterministic fashion.”

ghs.en: Youko: "Extremely deterministically so, as well."

rows.jp: 「確定的に……」
rows.en: “Deterministic...”

ghs.en: Taichi: "Deterministically..."

rows.jp: 「たとえば太一はＡを選ぶ。太一はＡを選んだことを自覚している」
rows.en: “Suppose you choose A. You are conscious of having chosen A.”

ghs.en: Youko: "For example, Taichi selects A. Taichi has the memory of choosing A."

rows.jp: 「けど同時に、その同じ世界軸にはＢを選んだ太一も存在する」
rows.en: “But at the same time, that same world axis also contains a version of you who chose B.”

ghs.en: Youko: "Yet simultaneously, on that same world axis a Taichi that has selected B also exists."

rows.jp: 「並列的な世界の存在を意味するものではないけれど……」
rows.en: “That doesn’t mean parallel worlds exist in the popular sense...”

ghs.en: Youko: "It does not imply the existence of parallel universes, however..."

rows.jp: 「ただ少なくともディラックの概念では、Ａ選択世界からＢ選択世界を知覚することは不可能。逆もまた然り」
rows.en: “But under Dirac's conception, at least, the world in which A was chosen cannot perceive the world in which B was chosen, nor vice versa.”

ghs.en: Youko: "Merely that in the general concept of Dirac, perception of the world of Selection B from the world of Selection A is not possible. And vice versa."

rows.jp: 「逆に知覚できるなら、世界間の移行はありうる」
rows.en: “Conversely, if perception were possible, passage between worlds would be possible.”

ghs.en: Youko: "Conversely, if there is capability of observation, transfer between the worlds becomes possible."

rows.jp: 「紫外線を目視できる者にとって、世界がまったく違うものであるように」
rows.en: “Just as the world itself would be utterly different for someone who could see ultraviolet light.”

ghs.en: Youko: "Similarly to how the world is a completely different thing for those who could see in the ultraviolet,"

rows.jp: 「多世界を観測しえた者は、その二つの世界に存在することができる」
rows.en: “A person capable of observing multiple worlds could exist in both.”

ghs.en: Youko: "one capable of observing many worlds is capable of existing in those two worlds."

rows.jp: 「観測が成立した瞬間、その世界の者になっている……とも考えられる」
rows.en: “You might even say that, at the instant observation becomes possible, they become an inhabitant of that world.”

ghs.en: Youko: "The instant observation comes into being, he will become an occupant of that world... or so it is thought."

rows.en: “Observed... it?”

ghs.en: Taichi: "Observation... into being...?"

rows.jp: 「世界は変わらずそこにあって、要するに見る者の違いってことかな？」
rows.en: “The world is still where it always was, and the only difference is the observer?”

ghs.en: Taichi: "No change of the world in there, or in other words, it's just a difference in the observer, then?"

rows.jp: 「そんな感じ」
rows.en: “Something like that.”

ghs.en: Youko: "Something of that sort."

rows.jp: 「ただ多世界観測は、現行の理論ではありえない」
rows.en: “But observing multiple worlds is impossible under current theory.”

ghs.en: Youko: "However, many worlds observation is impossible in current theories."

rows.jp: 「私たち複数が一斉に移行した理由にもならないし」
rows.en: “And it wouldn’t explain why several of us crossed at once.”

ghs.en: Youko: "There is also no reason for us all to have transferred in unison either."

rows.jp: 「だからＳＦ」
rows.en: “That’s why I call it science fiction.”

ghs.en: Youko: "Therefore, SF."
Taichi: "...hmmm."

rows.jp: 「二つ目の可能性については？」
rows.en: “And the second possibility?”

ghs.en: Taichi: "And with regards to the second possibility?"

rows.jp: 「私は、こちらが本命だと思う」
rows.en: “I think it is more likely.”

ghs.en: Youko: "This one is the likely correct one, I think."

rows.jp: 「つまり他の世界は観測されてない」
rows.en: “In other words, no other world has been observed.”

ghs.en: Youko: "In short there is no observation of another world."

rows.jp: 「……んー、さっきのＳＦ解釈はナシってことね」
rows.en: “...So the science-fiction explanation is out.”

ghs.en: Taichi: "...hmmm, so you say that SF interpretation of before is a no-go, right."

rows.jp: 端正な顔が頷く。
rows.en: Her refined features dipped in a nod.

ghs.en: A noble face nods.

rows.jp: 「世界、時間、固有の歴史。すべて一続きのもの」
rows.en: “World, time, unique history—all one continuous thing.”

ghs.en: Youko: "The world, the time, the eigenhistory: all are things of continuity and sequence."

rows.jp: 「つまり……時間も巻き戻ってはいない」
rows.en: “Meaning... time itself has not rewound.”

ghs.en: Youko: "In other words... time is not being rewound."

rows.en: “...What?”

ghs.en: Taichi: "...eh?"

rows.jp: 「それはおかしいよ。日記には月曜から土曜あたりまで記述があって……そこからまた月曜に戻っていたりするんだけど？」
rows.en: “That makes no sense. The diaries record Monday through around Saturday... and then return to Monday.”

ghs.en: Taichi: "But that's weird. In the diaries there are descriptions from Monday up around Saturday... and from there it returns back to Monday, doesn't it?"

rows.jp: 「ループしているように見えるに過ぎない」
rows.en: “It only appears to loop.”

ghs.en: Youko: "The time loop exists in no more than appearances."

rows.jp: 「当然世界は、永遠の時を繰り返しているのではない」
rows.en: “Naturally, the world is not repeating the same span of time for eternity.”

ghs.en: Youko: "The natural world is not repeating the same time over and over eternally."
ghs.assessment: 当然 is the sentence adverb 'of course,' not an adjective making this a 'natural world.'
ghs.remedy: Of course, the world

highlights.text: The natural world

rows.jp: 「この結末が、世界の確定的な結末だった」
rows.en: “This ending was the world’s determinate end.”

ghs.en: Youko: "This end is the deterministically derived end of the world."

rows.jp: 「世界は交差していない。異変は起きてはいない。一続き。もともと、こうなる可能性が許容されていた世界で、私たちは可能性に乗って順当に今に立った」
rows.en: “The worlds did not cross. No anomaly occurred. It is all continuous. This world had always allowed for the possibility of ending this way, and we simply followed that possibility to the present.”

ghs.en: Youko: "Worlds are not crossing. No unusual phenomenon is occurring. All is sequential. This possibility was permitted from the beginning of the world, and we rode down that possibility to find ourselves here, exactly where we were expected to be."

rows.jp: 「多世界間での知覚の交錯が起こったように見えるけれど、実際は一繋がりの道を進んでいるだけ」
rows.en: “What looks like perception crossing between worlds is actually nothing more than progress along one continuous path.”

ghs.en: Youko: "It may be seen as if an intermixing of perceptions between many worlds has occurred, however, in reality we are only advancing on a road connected by a single thread."

rows.jp: 「ループしているようにって……実際俺たち、何度もリセットかけられているわけで……」
rows.en: “Looks like a loop? We’ve actually been reset over and over...”

ghs.en: Taichi: "The loop is only appearances, you say... but in reality, we have been subjected to a reset many times over, so..."

rows.jp: 「そもそも元の世界でループなんて現象、起こったこと……」
rows.en: “And there was never any looping phenomenon in our original world...”

ghs.en: Taichi: "For this loop phenomenon to happen in our world of origin to begin with, it would mean..."

rows.jp: 気づいた。
rows.en: I realized.

ghs.en: I realized.

rows.jp: そうか。
rows.en: Of course.

ghs.en: Of course...

rows.jp: 「自覚できないんだ……」
rows.en: “We couldn’t be conscious of it...”

ghs.en: Taichi: "We could never be aware of it..."

rows.jp: ループが起こったことを、俺たちは本来自覚できない。
rows.en: Ordinarily, we would have no way to know a loop had happened.

ghs.en: By its nature we could never notice the occurrence of a loop.

rows.jp: 祠という特殊な場所が存在してくれない限り。
rows.en: Not without a special place like the shrine.

ghs.en: Should the unique location that is the hokora not have existed,

rows.jp: 現象は決して露見しない。
rows.en: The phenomenon would never reveal itself.

ghs.en: the phenomenon could by no means have been discovered.

rows.jp: 「世界には、もともとループという現象が予定されていた？　人類の黄昏として？」
rows.en: “Was looping always built into the world? As the twilight of humanity?”

ghs.en: Taichi: "Then was this loop phenomenon preordained in this world, from the beginning? As the twilight of mankind?"

rows.jp: 長い線路の端に。
rows.en: At the end of a long rail line.

ghs.en: And the end of its long track,

rows.jp: 何も大地が崩壊するばかりが、滅亡じゃないんだ。
rows.en: Extinction did not have to mean the ground breaking apart.

ghs.en: the collapse and destruction of all land, alone, is not the Downfall.

rows.jp: 時空が乱れて、先に進めなくなることが……終焉であることだって。
rows.en: Spacetime falling into disorder until forward progress became impossible—that could be an ending, too.

ghs.en: Space-time falls into disarray and ceases to progress onwards... that is its demise.
ghs.assessment: The narrator realizes that spacetime becoming disordered and unable to advance could itself count as an ending. The English removes this modal realization and asserts it as a settled definition.
ghs.remedy: that, too, could be an ending.

highlights.text: that is its demise.

rows.jp: 「でも……でもさ……」
rows.en: “But... even so...”

ghs.en: Taichi: "But... but say..."

rows.jp: 「特定の条件……この場合、日曜日の規定時間に到達した時、世界は一度分解されている……としか言えない」
rows.en: “All I can say is that when a specific condition is met—in this case, the designated time on Sunday—the world is disassembled once.”

ghs.en: Youko: "It has specific requirements... in this case, when the specified time on Sunday is reached, the world is at once dismantled... no more than this can be said."

rows.jp: 「空間的に記録された情報に従って、分解された粒子が収束、月曜朝の状態に戻る」
rows.en: “Following the information recorded in space, the disassembled particles converge and restore Monday morning’s state.”

ghs.en: Youko: "Following the recorded spatial information, the disassembled particles reorganize and return to the aspect of Monday."
ghs.assessment: The particles return specifically to their Monday-morning state. 'Aspect of Monday' omits morning and does not express restoration of a state.
ghs.remedy: return to their state on Monday morning

highlights.text: return to the aspect of Monday

rows.jp: 「でも、世界としては一続き……」
rows.en: “But as a world, it remains continuous...”

ghs.en: Taichi: "But for the world it's all continuous..."

rows.jp: 「その証拠として、例の社をあげる」
rows.en: “The shrine is evidence of that.”

ghs.en: Youko: "As evidence of that, I offer that shrine."

rows.jp: 「ノートの記述内容は過去の存在を示すものよ」
rows.en: “The writing in the notebooks demonstrates that the past exists.”

ghs.en: Youko: "The subject of the descriptions in the notebooks is what shows the existence of a past."

rows.jp: 「過去が観測できる以上、過去はある」
rows.en: “If the past can be observed, there is a past.”

ghs.en: Youko: "Since the past can be observed, the past exists."

rows.jp: 「この世界は、過去を許容しているということね」
rows.en: “This world admits its past.”

ghs.en: Youko: "This world here permits a past."

rows.jp: 「そして私たちは、何度も分解され構築されてここにいる」
rows.en: “And we are here after being disassembled and reconstructed again and again.”

ghs.en: Youko: "And then, here we are, one by one, having been dismantled many times and assembled many times."

rows.jp: 「……厳密に言えば、私たちはもう人ではない気がする」
rows.en: “...Strictly speaking, I don't think we're human anymore.”

ghs.en: Youko: "...I have the feeling that we are not, strictly speaking, people anymore."

rows.jp: 「じゃあ何だっての？」
rows.en: “Then what are we?”

ghs.en: Taichi: "Well then, what are we?"

rows.jp: 「現象」
rows.en: “Phenomena.”

ghs.en: Youko: "A phenomenon."

rows.jp: 適切すぎる言葉が、心に染みた。
rows.en: The word sank into me, almost too fitting.

ghs.en: A word too appropriate that soaked into my heart.

rows.jp: もう人じゃない―――
rows.en: No longer people—

ghs.en: People no more---

rows.jp: 「君は一繋がり説だって言ったけど、でも俺には前者の方もそれっぽく聞こえる。どっちが正しいか、今のところは判断できないんじゃあ……」
rows.en: “You favor the continuous-world theory, but the first one sounds plausible to me too. We can’t decide which is correct yet, can we?”

ghs.en: Taichi: "You say that it's the single thread theory, but to my ears the first one sounds more like it. We can't discern which is correct at this point in time, you know..."
ghs.assessment: Taichi says the first theory also sounds plausible. The English says it sounds more correct than the continuous-world theory.
ghs.remedy: the first theory sounds plausible too

highlights.text: the first one sounds more like it

rows.jp: 「私たちにとってループしているように見えても、実際どうかは調べようがないの」
rows.en: “Even if it appears to loop from our perspective, we have no way to investigate what is actually happening.”

ghs.en: Youko: "To us it is something that we see as a loop, but what it is in reality we can't investigate."

rows.jp: 「……だったらまずは、今ある理論を適用するしかない」
rows.en: “...Then we have no choice but to start by applying the theory we have.”

ghs.en: Youko: "...therefore, to start with we have no choice but to adopt one of the theories we have now."
ghs.assessment: Youko says they must begin by applying current theory. The English adds a choice among multiple theories, which is not stated.
ghs.remedy: start by applying the theory currently available to us

highlights.text: adopt one of the theories we have now

rows.jp: 「現状、世界間の移動はありえないと思われるから、移動なしの仮定としての後者」
rows.en: “At present, passage between worlds is considered impossible. So if we assume no passage, we arrive at the second model.”

ghs.en: Youko: "Presently, motion between worlds appears to be impossible, therefore it is the one without the assumption of movement, or the latter."

rows.jp: 「ああ、なるほど……」
rows.en: “Ah. I see...”

ghs.en: Taichi: "Ahhh, I see..."

rows.jp: 量子力学における多世界解釈は、並列的世界の存在を裏付けるものじゃない。
rows.en: The many-worlds interpretation of quantum mechanics does not establish the existence of parallel worlds.

ghs.en: The Many Worlds Interpretation of quantum mechanics does not substantiate the existence of parallel universes.

rows.jp: それは誤認であり、実際はもっと確定的な思考実験だ。
rows.en: That is a popular misconception. In reality, it is a far more deterministic thought experiment.

ghs.en: That is a misconception; in practice it's a much more deterministic thought experiment.

rows.jp: そこでは、世界Ａと世界Ｂは同時に存在しているが行き来はできない。
rows.en: World A and World B both exist, but no passage between them is possible.

ghs.en: In there, a World A and a World B can exist simultaneously, but it is impossible to traverse between them,

rows.jp: なぜなら同時に存在しているからだ。
rows.en: Because they exist simultaneously.

ghs.en: because of that very simultaneous existence.

rows.jp: このあたり、理解が少々厄介ではある。
rows.en: This was where things became a little difficult to follow.

ghs.en: Around this part, my understanding becomes a little confused.

rows.jp: 「ディラック、せめて訳書があれば読んだんだけど」
rows.en: “Dirac... If only I had a translation. I'd have read it.”

ghs.en: Taichi: "I would have read Dirac if there had been a translation, but..."

rows.jp: 「仮に従来の理論を逸脱していたとしても」
rows.en: “Even if this does depart from conventional theory—”

ghs.en: Youko: "Even if we were to deviate from conventional theories,"

rows.jp: 「起こりえないと思っていたことが起きた。それだけのことよ」
rows.en: “Something we believed impossible has happened. That is all.”

ghs.en: Youko: "something we believed could not happen has. That and nothing more."

rows.jp: 「物理的な地平は広くて、人はまだその全てに手を広げたわけじゃない」
rows.en: “The horizons of physics are vast. Humanity has yet to reach across all of them.”

ghs.en: Youko: "The horizon of all things physics is vast, and people are yet to lay their hands over all of it."

rows.jp: 「そして今の私たちに、理論は些細なことでしかない」
rows.en: “And for us now, theory is a trivial concern.”

ghs.en: Youko: "And then, to us as we are right now theories are nothing but trifles."

rows.jp: 「必要なのは、なに？」
rows.en: “What do you need?”

ghs.en: Youko: "What is necessary is... what?"

rows.jp: 「わからない」
rows.en: “I don’t know.”

ghs.en: Taichi: "I dunno."

rows.jp: 「理解者、でしょう？」
rows.en: “Someone who understands you. Right?”

ghs.en: Youko: "Someone who understands, don't we?"
ghs.assessment: The Japanese offers 'someone who understands you' as what is needed. The English uses a mismatched question tag and leaves the proposition incomplete.
ghs.remedy: Someone who understands you, right?

highlights.text: Someone who understands, don't we?

rows.jp: 微笑む。
rows.en: She smiled.

ghs.en: Smiling.
Taichi: "......"

rows.jp: 「太一の理解者なら、ここにいる」
rows.en: “The person who understands you is right here.”

ghs.en: Youko: "And someone who understands you, Taichi, is here with you."

rows.jp: 「他の誰も、あなたのことを理解してはくれない」
rows.en: “No one else will ever understand you.”

ghs.en: Youko: "No one else will give you understanding of what you are."
ghs.assessment: Youko says nobody else will understand Taichi. The English instead describes giving him an abstract understanding of what he is.
ghs.remedy: No one else will understand you.

highlights.text: give you understanding of what you are

rows.jp: 「擬態をすればするほど……」
rows.en: “The more you disguise yourself...”

ghs.en: Youko: "For the more you camouflage yourself..."

rows.jp: そうだ。
rows.en: Yes.

ghs.en: Right.

rows.jp: 当然のことだ。
rows.en: Of course.

ghs.en: It is a matter of course.

rows.jp: 人のフリをすれば、フリだけが自分になってしまう。
rows.en: Pretend to be human, and eventually the act becomes all that you are.

ghs.en: If I'm pretending to be a person, nothing but pretension is what my self will become.

rows.jp: 隠した内面を見られたが最後、おしまいだ。
rows.en: The moment anyone sees the self you've kept hidden, it's over.

ghs.en: If my concealed hidden interior is seen it's the end, all over.

rows.jp: 思い出す。
rows.en: I remembered.

ghs.en: I remember.

rows.jp: 「わかってたさ……そんなこと」
rows.en: “I knew that... I'd always known.”

ghs.en: Taichi: "I get that... you know."

rows.jp: 「あのときから、とうに！」
rows.en: “Ever since then!”

ghs.en: Taichi: "Ever since that time, so long ago!"

rows.jp: 「いいお部屋ですね」
rows.en: “What a lovely room.”

ghs.en: Yusa: "You have a nice room."

rows.jp: 堂島遊紗。
rows.en: Yusa Dojima.

ghs.en: Doujima Yusa.

rows.jp: いい子だった。
rows.en: She had been a good person.

ghs.en: What a nice girl she was.

rows.jp: 純真で健気で。
rows.en: Innocent and brave.

ghs.en: So naive and brave.

rows.jp: 病を心に秘めていても、人を傷つけることも知らない。
rows.en: Even with an illness hidden in her heart, she didn't know how to hurt anyone.

ghs.en: Even hiding the disease in the heart it's still possible to not know you are hurting someone.
ghs.assessment: The Japanese says that despite the illness hidden in her heart, Yusa did not even know how to hurt people. The English turns this into a general claim about unknowingly inflicting current harm.
ghs.remedy: Even with the sickness hidden in her heart, she didn't know how to hurt anyone.

highlights.text: Even hiding the disease in the heart it's still possible to not know you are hurting someone.

rows.jp: 「あの……ここの変化がわからないんですけど……」
rows.en: “Um... I don’t understand what changed here...”

ghs.en: Yusa: "Uhm... I don't understand this change, so..."

rows.jp: 俺の目には、甘い水。
rows.en: To my eyes, she was sweet water.

ghs.en: In my eyes, sweet water.

rows.jp: 「……太一さん？」
rows.en: “...Taichi?”

ghs.en: Yusa: "...Taichi-san?"

rows.jp: 終焉は、唐突だった。
rows.en: The end came without warning.

ghs.en: The demise... was abrupt.

rows.jp: 不意にあらわれた俺の内面は、彼女にとって猛毒となった。
rows.en: The part of me that suddenly surfaced was poison to her.

ghs.en: The sudden materialization of my interior was, to her, like swallowing a deadly poison.

rows.jp: 「太一……さん……ですよね？」
rows.en: “You’re... Taichi... aren’t you?”

ghs.en: Yusa: "Are you even... Taichi... san?"

rows.jp: 「ああ、そうだよ」
rows.en: “Yes. That’s me.”

ghs.en: Taichi: "Yup, I am."

rows.jp: 「あ、あの……わた、し……」

ghs.en: Yusa: "Ah, uhm... I-, I..."

rows.jp: 「キレイだね」
rows.en: “You’re beautiful.”

ghs.en: Taichi: "So pretty, yes."

rows.jp: 俺の瞳は光っていたのだろう。
rows.en: My eyes must have been shining.

ghs.en: My eyes by now must've been shining,

rows.jp: 欲望で爛々と。
rows.en: Blazing with desire.

ghs.en: blazing with appetite.

rows.jp: 「キレイだから、服を脱ぐんだ」
rows.en: “You’re beautiful, so take off your clothes.”

ghs.en: Taichi: "Pretty, therefore, off with the clothes."

rows.jp: 肉食の野生動物に見つめられたことがあればわかる。
rows.en: Anyone who has met the gaze of a wild predator will understand.

ghs.en: One who has ever been stared at by a wild carnivorous animal knows it,

rows.jp: ギョロッと血走った双眼が、注目してくる。
rows.en: A pair of bloodshot eyes swivels and fixes on you.

ghs.en: what it is like to have the attention of two wide open, bulging, bloodshot eyes.

rows.jp: 好意でも悪意でもない。
rows.en: There is neither affection nor malice in them.

ghs.en: Neither favoritism nor malice there.
ghs.assessment: The gaze contains neither affection nor malice. 'Favoritism' means preferential treatment and does not denote positive feeling.
ghs.remedy: Neither affection nor malice.

highlights.text: Neither favoritism nor malice there.

rows.jp: とんでもないほど熱っぽい視線は……だが食欲だ。
rows.en: That impossibly feverish gaze... is appetite.

ghs.en: A gaze enthusiastic and feverish to absurd extent that is... nevertheless hunger.

rows.jp: 人間である自分を、食べ物としか認識してない目。
rows.en: Eyes that recognize a human being as nothing but food.

ghs.en: Eyes that recognize the self, the human self, as nothing but food.

rows.jp: 熱烈なる食欲が、自分に注がれるのだ。
rows.en: A ravenous appetite bears down on you.

ghs.en: Boiling hot hunger is poured inside the self.
ghs.assessment: The fierce appetite is directed at the person being watched. The English instead describes hunger being poured inside that person's self.
ghs.remedy: is fixed intently upon you

highlights.text: is poured inside the self

rows.jp: 時には吐き気さえ催すだろう。
rows.en: At times, it may even make you sick.

ghs.en: It's possible it could, occasionally, even induce nausea.

rows.jp: 彼女のように。
rows.en: As it did her.

ghs.en: Just like in her.

rows.jp: 「い……いやぁぁぁぁぁぁぁぁっ！！」
rows.en: “N-no... Nooooooooo!”

ghs.en: Yusa: "N-... NOOOOOOOOO!!!"

rows.jp: 「……気持ち……悪い……っ」
rows.en: “...Disgusting...”

ghs.en: Yusa: "...I feel... sick...!"

rows.en: “Ugh... uuu...”

ghs.en: Yusa: "Ngh... ngh..."

rows.jp: うずくまり、嘔吐にえずく少女を見下ろしながら、俺はそのくだらない結末にうんざりしていた。
rows.en: I looked down at the girl doubled over and retching, already sick of that pathetic ending.

ghs.en: I was looking down on a squatting little girl disgustingly vomiting her guts out, a conclusion of inferior quality that I grew bored of.
ghs.assessment: The girl crouches and retches while the narrator is disgusted or weary specifically with the pathetic ending. The English exaggerates the vomiting and makes the girl's action itself disgusting.
ghs.remedy: the girl crouched and retching, sick of how pathetic an ending it was

highlights.text: a squatting little girl disgustingly vomiting her guts out, a conclusion of inferior quality that I grew bored of

rows.jp: 壊す前に壊れた少女。
rows.en: A girl who broke before I could break her.

ghs.en: The girl broke before being broken.
Taichi: "......"

rows.jp: そして、彼女は俺を避けるようになった。
rows.en: After that, she avoided me.

ghs.en: And then, it came that the girl began to avoid me.

rows.jp: 汚物を見るような目に、変わった。
rows.en: Her eyes had changed. They looked at me as though I were filth.

ghs.en: Her eyes changed into something that saw me as if filth.

rows.jp: 実際、俺は汚物だったのだ。
rows.en: And I really was filth.

ghs.en: Truth is, I was filth indeed.

rows.jp: 俺は―――
rows.en: I—

rows.jp: 「いれば傷つけるだけ」
rows.en: “If they're here, you'll only hurt them.”

ghs.en: Youko: "If they are here you will only wound."
ghs.assessment: Youko says that merely having the others around means Taichi will hurt them. The English omits the object of 'wound' and leaves the thought incomplete.
ghs.remedy: If they're around, you'll only hurt them.

highlights.text: If they are here you will only wound.

rows.jp: 「太一のエサでしかない」
rows.en: “They're nothing but food to you.”

ghs.en: Youko: "They are but prey for you, Taichi."

rows.jp: 「うるさい、だからわかってるって！」
rows.en: “Shut up! I told you I know!”

ghs.en: Taichi: "Shaddap, that's why I toldya I get it!"

rows.jp: 曜子ちゃんは押し黙る。
rows.en: Youko fell silent.

ghs.en: Youko-chan keeps silent.

rows.jp: 「でもできたら、そんなことは……ない……そうはしたくない……」
rows.en: “But if I can help it, that won't... happen... I don't want it to...”

ghs.en: Taichi: "But I if I could, I would... never... I don't want to do that..."

rows.jp: 「なんとかなるはずだ……」
rows.en: “There has to be some way...”

ghs.en: Taichi: "I should just manage somehow..."

rows.jp: 「私だけがいればいい」
rows.en: “I’m the only person you need.”

ghs.en: Youko: "It would be best if only I were to be."

rows.jp: 自分の胸元を押さえて。
rows.en: She pressed a hand to her chest.

ghs.en: She presses her hands to her chest.

rows.jp: 「私だったら、太一とうまくやれるから」
rows.en: “I can make it work with you.”

ghs.en: Youko: "Because I alone can go make this go well for you, Taichi."
ghs.assessment: Youko says that she can get along successfully with Taichi. The English makes her manage an unspecified situation on his behalf instead.
ghs.remedy: Because I can make things work with you, Taichi.

highlights.text: I alone can go make this go well for you

rows.jp: どす黒い感情が、下腹部にたちこめた。
rows.en: A pitch-black emotion welled in my lower belly.

ghs.en: Dark, sinister emotions enshrouded the lower abdomen.
